FIFTH AMENDMENT
to Lease Agreement
by and between
Jawed lqbal ("Lessor") and Online Classifieds Pakistan (SMC-Private) Limited ("Lessee")
[Each a "Party" and, collectively, "Parties"]
This fifth amendment ("Fifth Amendment") to the Lease Agreement dated 1st October, 2017
amended through First Amendment dated 6th November, 2020, Second Amendment dated 261h
October, 2020, Third Amendment dated 30th September, 2021, Fourth Amendment dated 29th
September, 2022 and Novation Agreement dated 13tI November, 2024 (hereinafter collectively
referred to as the "Agreement"), is made and entered into at Lahore on this 29t September,
2025.
WHEREAS
(A)

The Lessor is the sole and absolute owner of a multi-storeyed commercial building
situated at S-1IS-2, SQ25, Chak 213/RB, Susan Road, Madina Town, Faisalabad (the
"Building");

(B)

The Parties entered into the Agreement wherein the Lessor granted on lease, and the
Lessee took on lease from the Lessee, entire

Floor of the Building measuring 2600

sq.ft ("Premises"); and
(C)

The Parties hereby mutually agree to revise and amend the Agreement, as per the terms
and conditions of this Fifth Amendment.

NOW, THEREFORE, the Parties agree as follows:
1.

The Fifth Amendment shall come into force on

2.

Pursuant to Clause 1.2 of the Agreement, the Parties hereby mutually agree to extend the

October, 2025 ("Effective Date").

term of the Agreement for a further period of three (3) years, commencing from the Effective
Date and ending on 301h September, 2028 ("Extended Term").
3.

Pursuant to Clause 2.2 of the Agreement, the monthly rent of the Premises is hereby
increased by ten percent (10%). Accordingly, the monthly rent •.abl- ey the e see to

the Lessor during the first year of the Extended Term shall be Rs. 214,359 (Rupees Two
Hundred Fourteen Thousand Three Hundred Fifty-Nine) inclusive of tax ("Rent").
4.

This Fifth Amendment shall be read as an integral part of the Agreement.

5.

All other terms and provisions in the Agreement shall mutatis mutandis apply and shall
continue in full force and effect in accordance with the terms mentioned therein. In the event
of any conflict, the terms of this Fifth Amendment shall prevail, and any conflicting term in
the Agreement shall be deemed amended appropriately.

6.

All expressions and terms defined or used in the Agreement shall bear the same meaning
in this Fifth Amendment, unless otherwise specified herein.

7.

This Fifth Amendment may be entered into in counterparts, all of which taken together shall
constitute one and the same amendment.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties hereto have signed this Fifth Amendment, having fully
understood the conditions set therein, of their own free will, in the presence of witnesses.
